title: Performer pattern
description: One performer pattern: a step matrix with one lane per string (or voice), read as JSON-compatible data from a YAML or JSON file. The rules the schema cannot say (every row one cell per step, a manual lane without a row, at least one hit) are in docs/performer-format.md; validate with 'apc64 lab validate-pattern <file>'.

name.description: The pattern's name (the unit's OLED shows 14 characters).

meter.description: Beats per bar / beat unit: 4/4, 3/4, 6/8. It sets where the bars fall (the | of the canonical rows).

step.description: One step's length: a quarter, an eighth, a sixteenth, an eighth or sixteenth triplet.

length.description: Steps in the pattern (it loops); without it, the rows' cell count.

lanes.description: Lane → its row of cells. A lane number 1–16 (with strings addressing lane 1 is the highest string), or a lane that follows the chord held: R (the root string; with voices addressing the lowest held voice) or A (the alternate bass: root on string 6 or 5 → string 4, on 4 → 3, else the next string up; with voices the second lowest voice). A string an R or A hit covers at a step plays once.

strum.description: One mark per step: d (down: the hits of that step spread from the lowest string to the highest), u (up: highest to lowest), . (all at once).

spread.description: Milliseconds between the strings of a strum.

swing.description: Percent: every second step moves later; 50 is straight, 66 a triplet feel, 75 the most.

play.description: all: every pattern lane plays at its hits, a string with nothing pressed its open note, except a string below the chord's root string, which stays silent (with voices addressing an unheld voice rests); pressed: only lanes with a pressed note play. Either way a missing note leaves its step silent and never moves a later step.

gate.description: ring: a note rings until its lane's next hit (or the chord changes there); a number: it lasts that many steps.

velocity.description: The velocity of an x (hit) and an X (accent) at a full press; each is scaled by the press velocity.

manual.description: Lanes played by hand (strings addressing): presses there pass straight through, as played; such a lane has no row. R and A cannot be manual.

row.description: One cell per step: . rest, x hit, X accent; spaces and | are ignored.
